paragraphs.text:
You draw up just in time. Another few steps and you would have 
fallen a hundred feet into that ravine! You must get a grip on 
yourself. Drink another day’s water ration and choose a direction: 
for North, go to 255; for East, go to 232; for South, go to 279; 
for West, go to 299. And be careful!
(232, 257)
